verdict.rationale: The quickstart states that every new E2B account gets $100 in credits. The docs describe a self-serve Base tier alongside Pro (1-hour vs 24-hour sessions), and setup is a self-serve API-key flow, with no sales contact mentioned anywhere. Missing for 10: details on credit terms (expiry, whether a credit card is required) and independent or hands-on confirmation that signup is fully self-serve.
